title: when 与 while

examples.en: I was reading when he came in.
examples.zh: 他进来的时候我正在看书。

examples.en: While I was reading, he was watching TV.
examples.zh: 我看书的时候，他在看电视。

guess.question: 同样是“当……的时候”，为什么一句用 when，一句用 while？

options.text: when 后面可以接短暂动作，while 后面要接持续的动作
options.feedback: 对！come in 是一瞬间的事，只能用 when；看书、看电视是持续动作，用 while 更贴。

options.text: while 更正式，when 更口语
options.feedback: 不对——正式程度不是判据，后面动词的“长短”才是。
不对——后面是瞬间动词（came、rang）时，只能用 when。

left.label: when
left.formula: when + 一般过去时 或 过去进行时

anchor.en: I was reading when he came in.
anchor.zh: 他进来的时候我正在看书。

left.focus: 后面可以接瞬间动作（came / rang / arrived），也可以接持续动作

right.label: while
right.formula: while + 过去进行时（持续动作）

anchor.en: While I was reading, he was watching TV.
anchor.zh: 我看书的时候，他在看电视。

right.focus: 后面必须是持续动作，常表示两个动作同时进行

contrast.diff: 从句动词是 come / arrive / ring / leave 这类一瞬间完成的动作 → 只能用 when；要表达“两个动作同时进行” → 用 while 最贴切。

traps.wrong: While he came in, I was reading.
traps.right: When he came in, I was reading.
traps.why: came in 是瞬间动作，不能放在 while 后面。

traps.wrong: I was reading while the phone rang.
traps.right: I was reading when the phone rang.
traps.why: 电话响是瞬间动作，要用 when。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住一条就够：瞬间动作用 when，两个动作同时进行用 while。

check.stem: He was doing his homework ____ his mother came back.

options.distractor: came back 是瞬间动作，不能用 while
这里要表达“正在做的时候”，不是“一……就”
妈妈回来时他正在做，不是回来之后才做

check.explanation: came back 是瞬间动作，用 when。

check.stem: I was reading ____ my sister was listening to music.

options.distractor: 两边都是持续动作且同时进行，用 while 更贴切

check.explanation: 两边都是过去进行时，表示同时进行的两个动作，用 while。

options.text: When he came in, I was writing a letter.
While I was sleeping, he left quietly.
While the bell rang, we were talking.
When I got home, Mum was cooking dinner.

check.explanation: 铃响是瞬间动作，应改为 When the bell rang, we were talking。
